info_icon_spec.behavior: Hovering (or tapping on mobile) the ⓘ next to any phase or widget label opens a tooltip. Tooltip shows: what this is called in the other two frameworks, plus a one-line plain-English definition.

example.label: Barrier Analysis ⓘ
example.tooltip: ADKAR: Shows which of Awareness / Desire / Knowledge / Ability / Reinforcement is blocking each group. Kotter equivalent: Barrier removal under 'Enable Action'. Lewin equivalent: Readiness gaps in 'Unfreeze'.

info_icon_spec.placement: To the right of the label, 16px, muted color, keyboard-focusable for accessibility.

info_icon.kotter: Evidence for Wins and Institute steps

widgets.label: Adoption Rate
widgets.plain_english: The share of people actually using the new way of working — the bottom-line measure of whether the change took hold.

widgets.label: Training Completion
widgets.plain_english: Whether people finished the training they need to work the new way — a readiness signal, not the outcome itself.

widgets.label: Communications Sent
widgets.plain_english: The reach of change communications: what has been sent, what has been seen, and what is still pending.

widgets.label: Open Risks
widgets.plain_english: Threats to the change effort and their severity — what needs a mitigation plan before it becomes an issue.

widgets.label: Stakeholder Engagement
widgets.plain_english: How informed, involved, and bought in each stakeholder group is — engagement is what turns awareness into support.

widgets.label: Sponsor Coalition Health
widgets.plain_english: Whether the leaders sponsoring the change are visible, active, and aligned — sponsorship is the single biggest predictor of success.

info_icon.adkar: Primary view: which ADKAR element is the blocker

widgets.label: Barrier Analysis
widgets.plain_english: What is getting in people's way — the obstacles, resistance points, and friction slowing adoption.

info_icon.kotter: Hero widget for Generate Short-Term Wins

widgets.label: Quick Wins Log
widgets.plain_english: Early, visible successes that prove the change is working — momentum builders worth celebrating loudly.

widgets.label: Readiness Score
widgets.plain_english: How prepared the organization is to absorb the change — capacity, willingness, and conditions before you begin.

widgets.label: Sustainment Health
widgets.plain_english: Whether the change is holding after go-live — reinforcement, ownership, and results over time.

widgets.label: Milestones
widgets.plain_english: The key dates and deliverables marking the change journey — and whether each is on track.

widgets.label: Recent Activity
widgets.plain_english: The latest movement across the change effort — what has been happening recently.
